entries.name: Pharmacy
entries.description: A 15m by 15m full-envelope pharmacy parcel. A substantial two-storey neighbourhood pharmacy with 9m long front facade and 7m deep side facade: exactly 6m wall height (two 3m storeys), slate hipped roof, cream-stone broad walls. One normal 2.1m personnel door and broad muted glass storefront, one low muted green canopy. One large recognizable green cross on the front upper facade, at least 1.5m tall. Broad upper windows, no fine panes or lettering. Architecture size equals cafe. Expand equipment spacing, paths and planted groups across the 15m envelope; add architectural wings where appropriate without changing any human-feature height.
